hero.eyebrow: United in purpose, blessed in stride
hero.title: True nobility lies in the <emphasis>hands that give.</emphasis>
hero.description: Since 2016, TunisAid has funded and delivered projects across Tunisia — from emergency COVID-19 relief for hospitals to long-term educational support for children with multiple disabilities.

impact.title: We turn commitment into action.
impact.description: From hospital relief during the pandemic to wheelchairs and classrooms for children with disabilities — we don't just advocate for a better future, we build the infrastructure for it, one wheelchair and one food box at a time.
